Game Overview

In Bridge Race Wedding Master, the core idea is straightforward: embrace a whimsical, romance-themed dash in Bridge Race Wedding Master. Race to build your dream wedding bridge while collecting flowers and cakes. Compete against others, avoiding pesky obstacles, to boost your love score and reach the altar. Experience love in motion with exhilarating parkour challenges.
